title: Course Schedule
description: Determine if you can finish all courses given prerequisites using cycle detection in a directed graph.
pseudocode:
1. build adjacency list from prerequisites
2. state array: 0=unvisited, 1=visiting, 2=visited
3. for each course i: if state[i] == 0 and hasCycle(i) return false
4. return true
5. function hasCycle(node):
6. state[node] = 1
7. for neighbor in adj[node]:
8. if state[neighbor] == 1: return true
9. if state[neighbor] == 0 and hasCycle(neighbor): return true
10. state[node] = 2; return false

steps.note: Node 0 is already in state 1, cycle detected!
